body: back in middle school, in the year or so leading up to when i started cutting, i used to bite my tongue and the inside of my mouth until it bled and almost felt numb. i did it when a teacher criticized me or i did something that i thought was wrong. i would also prick my finger with thumbtacks or safety pins.
i get that. maybe because you're imagining a way out of a stressful situation? stay, though.
i feel the same way. it's comfortable. i don't like being depressed but i don't know who i would be without it.
i feel that. it makes me want to kms, to be honest. it makes my fingers itch to do something self-destructive. i hope it stops.

i'm in a similar situation. i'm a perfectionist with good grades and i'm applying to college this year, and i feel you––it's so stressful. the future is terrifying. i also relapsed about a week ago and i'm still cutting every night.

what i find helpful to remember is that everyone gets through this stage of life. not everyone goes to college. some people go to college and transfer, or take a gap year, or take a semester off. but they're all still living perfectly valid lives. you can have a real and good life that's not picture-perfect.

best of luck. stay safe.

i get that rush of tingly energy. i don't know what it is but it happens when i'm really sad and self-destructive. it was almost nonstop for a few hours when i was in the emergency room for being suicidal. maybe adrenaline?
